spec.kitLine: Wish: ATK ▲46.46% of skill user's ATK
spec.assertion: buffApply stat casterAtkPct with value == 0.4646 × chime.staticAtk (flat-resolved), applied once at battle start, no finite expiresFrame, exactly one recipient. Fails under the nearest-wrong `atkPct` model (emits raw 46.46 and scales the RECIPIENT's ATK — counterfactual C2 moves the board), under a windowed re-read (finite expiry), and under an all-allies target (recipient set size > 1). Non-vacuity: removing the block (C1) lowers total damage.

No `theKing` primitive exists in the TargetDef vocabulary, so WHICH ally is designated is an encoding choice I cannot verify blind. Asserted encoding-agnostically as CARDINALITY == 1 recipient, which is true under any faithful single-ally encoding and false under `{kind:'allies'}`. The identity of the king is reported as a gap, not asserted.

spec.kitLine: Daily Report: Normal Atk Dmg Mult ▲46.22%
spec.assertion: buffApply stat normalAttackPct value 46.22. Fails under the nearest-wrong generic `attackDamagePct` (Damage-Up bucket) model, which additionally credits skill/burst damage — C5 counterfactual produces a different board total. "Damage MULTIPLIER" + the explicit "Normal Attack" scoping is the discriminator (taxonomy trap #1: SCOPE).

Application count == fullBurstStart event count (a TEAM full-burst trigger). Fails under the nearest-wrong `burstCast` keying, which fires pre-FB and only on rotations chime personally bursts — C4 counterfactual. Non-vacuity guarded by asserting fullBurstStart > 0 in the fixture (taxonomy trap #3: TRIGGER IDENTITY).

durationShots undefined + finite expiresFrame + consecutive applications' expiry gap > 600 frames (so a refresh cannot mask a wrong window). Fails under a "for N rounds" reading (durationShots set) and under a permanent reading (no expiry) — taxonomy trap #2: DURATION SEMANTICS.

reenterStage{stage:2}. Dropping it (C9) must change fullBurstStart count OR the board total — a rotation-shaped line cannot be inert. The full payload (a SECOND stage-2 unit casting in the same rotation) is it.skip'd: controlComp builds only one B2 slot.

buffApply maxAmmoPct 20 to MORE THAN ONE recipient (this line sits under the FIRST '■ Affects all allies' header), 10s window, and dropping it (C6) LOWERS team damage. The last clause is the taxonomy-#6 guard: a weapon-state modifier IS damage (bigger magazine → fewer reloads → more shots); an inert result would mean it was mis-classified as cosmetic.

buffApply attackDamagePct 92.44 (GENERIC Damage-Up — unlike skill2 this line carries no normal/charge/crit scoping), 10s, to exactly ONE recipient because a SECOND '■ Affects the king' header re-scopes it away from the all-allies block. Fails under the flat-burst-block reading: C8 (widened to allies) raises the board total. Inertness: dropping it (C7) moves exactly one unit's total, no teammate byte-shifts.

Cross-cutting inertness: chime's own damage events occupy only normal/core/crit buckets (no invented DoT/flatDamage/storedHit rider), and no boss-held buffApply (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) carries any of chime's four magnitudes.

fixtures: controlComp('chime', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / carry / helm B3, boss Fire, focus carry, deterministic (no seed). The fixed-B3 flag is left TRUE because chime is a Burst II support with no damage-scaling riders that helm's buffs could confound; what the fixture MUST guarantee instead is that the burst chain completes so Full Bursts actually occur — skill2 (fullBurstEnter) and the entire burst block are vacuous otherwise, and every FB-keyed assertion is explicitly guarded by `expect(fbStarts).toBeGreaterThan(0)`. All 9 counterfactuals reuse the same comp with a single withPatchedOverride swap so each delta isolates one kit line; 10 runComp calls total, all hoisted to module scope.
gaps: burst 'Re-enters Burst Stage 2' — the real payload (a second eligible stage-2 unit casting in the same rotation) is it.skip'd: controlComp provides a single Burst II slot, so there is no second B2 to hand the re-entered window to. The landed assertion only proves the effect is non-inert (FB count or board total moves when removed). Upgrade when a two-B2 fixture exists.

'Affects the king' (skill1, skill2, burst-Loyalty) — the schema's TargetDef vocabulary has no 'the king' primitive, and the kit prose alone does not say which ally is designated (highest ATK? a named unit? a user selection via `modes`?). I assert only that exactly ONE ally receives each of the three grants; the IDENTITY of the recipient is unverifiable blind and is a ⚑ for the driver/judge to reconcile. If the driver encoded it as alliesTopAtk{count:1} vs a mode-selected slot, my cardinality assertions pass under both — that divergence is invisible to this test file by construction.

Base-stat cadence (SMG pulls/sec, reloadFrames 81) is a datamined ALWAYS-⚑ field; the Max-Ammo assertion tests the DIRECTION of the shot-count effect (damage strictly increases) rather than a magnitude, because the exact shot-count delta depends on unreliable cadence data.
